post.summary: Send a push nudge for one order
post.description:
Sends an FCM push about a specific order to its vendor, its customer, or (for unassigned orders) up to 25 eligible nearby vendors, and records the nudge as a LeadLogs row.

**Notes:** Side effect: sends real push notifications. Rate limited to one nudge per audience per order every 15 minutes (429). Broadcasts are capped at 25 vendors. Wrapped in withAuditLog, which writes an AdminActivityLog row when a NextAuth session cookie is present but does NOT itdoes not enforce auth itself. Since 2026-09-05 middleware.ts is deny-by-default for /api/*, so an admin session is required at the edge.

_Source: `app/api/orders/nudge/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

get.summary: Read the customer-vendor chat for an order
get.description:
Read-only, cursor-paginated view of the customer-vendor chat thread for one order, including the pre-filter text of any message the contact-info filter rewrote. Restricted to root admins and the SUPER_ADMIN / MANAGER / TEAM_LEAD / EXECUTIVE roles.

post.summary: Reassign an order to a different vendor
post.description:
Moves the order to a new vendor inside one transaction: flags the outgoing vendor, repoints unresolved lead flags at them, updates the chat room and its VENDOR participant, posts a SYSTEM chat message and writes a REASSIGN lead log.

**Notes:** Side effects: creates a VendorFlag against the outgoing vendor and posts a SYSTEM message into the order's chat room. Wrapped in withAuditLog (ORDER/ASSIGN).

_Source: `app/api/orders/[leadId]/reassign/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

patch.summary: Reschedule an order's pickup date and slot
patch.description:
Moves an active order to a new pickup date and canonicalised time slot, writes a ReschedulePickup lead log capturing the previous values, and emails the customer and vendor.

**Notes:** Side effect: sends reschedule emails to the customer and (if present) the vendor about 1s after responding. WhatsApp is sent separately by CashkrBackend via Pabbly. Responds with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *. Wrapped in withAuditLog, which writes an AdminActivityLog row when a NextAuth session cookie is present but does NOT itdoes not enforce auth itself. Sets the disposition text on a master lead, increments its isCallRequested counter and appends a lead log entry describing the change.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check. Errors are returned with HTTP 200 and success:false, so clients must inspect the body rather than the status code. Side effects: increments isCallRequested and creates a MasterLeads lead log row. Audit-logged as ORDER/STATUS_CHANGE.

example.message: Invalid data types. Both leadid and desposition must be strings

MessageEnvelope.description: Message-only envelope `{ message }`; used for both success and failure responses.

SuccessMessageEnvelope.description: Envelope `{ success, message }`; `success` is `true` on 2xx and `false` on error responses.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthenticated - no valid admin session (NextAuth cookie), or the expected token/secret is missing or wrong. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

InternalServerError.description: Internal server error - unhandled failure inside the route handler. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

cookieAuth.name: next-auth.session-token
cookieAuth.description: NextAuth JWT session cookie from logging in to the admin panel. On HTTPS the cookie name is `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`.

cronBearer.description: `LINODE_CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token — every cron job goes through `assertCronAuth` in `lib/linode/cron-auth.ts`, which reads only this variable (despite some jobs being non-Linode).

unverifiedAccessToken.name: Authorization
unverifiedAccessToken.description: Legacy customer routes: an `accessToken` cookie or an `Authorization` header must be PRESENT, but the value is never verified. Not real authentication.

adsWebhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
adsWebhookSecret.description: `ADS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, sent either as the `x-webhook-secret` header or as a `secret` field in the JSON body. If the env var is unset the route rejects every call with 401 (it does not fall through to unauthenticated access).

webhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
webhookSecret.description: Generic `x-webhook-secret` header check for an inbound webhook.

cronSecretBearer.description: `CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token, compared with `bearerMatches` in `lib/auth/secret-compare.ts`. Distinct from `cronBearer`, which uses `LINODE_CRON_SECRET`.
